# GENERATED by tools/domiciles/build_family_estates.py (2026-11-26): noble family titles for Dynastic-rank domiciles.

# Character: a ruler on a Dynastic rank gets a noble family title, and with it the domicile (house seat)
LR_give_family_title_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_landed = yes
			exists = house
			LR_government_needs_family_title_trigger = yes
			NOT = { any_held_title = { is_noble_family_title = yes } }
			OR = {
				is_independent_ruler = yes
				highest_held_title_tier >= tier_county
			}
		}
		save_temporary_scope_as = LR_family_title_ruler
		if = {
			limit = { is_independent_ruler = yes }
			create_noble_family_effect = { GOVERNMENT_GIVER = scope:LR_family_title_ruler }
		}
		else = {
			create_noble_family_effect = { GOVERNMENT_GIVER = scope:LR_family_title_ruler.liege }
		}
		domicile ?= { set_up_domicile_estate_effect = yes }
	}
}

# Every ruler (after the lobby, when the GRADUS normalizer has set the governments)
LR_generate_family_titles_effect = {
	every_ruler = {
		limit = { LR_government_needs_family_title_trigger = yes }
		LR_give_family_title_effect = yes
	}
}
